caption: The drawing depicts a long, traditional dress with wide, full-length sleeves. The dress is primarily light beige or cream in color with gradients of pink and light brown shading throughout the fabric, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. Elaborate black embroidery with a floral and vine motif adorns the chest, upper arms, and sleeves, as well as down the center front of the dress. There are additional pink decorative elements on the lower sleeves, bordered by tassel-like black trim at the sleeve ends. The dress has a gathered waist and a rounded neckline with buttons or closures running down the front. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller illustration showing the back of the same dress, featuring similar embroidered patterns on the sleeves and shoulders, and displaying the gathered nature of the back and the general flow of the skirt. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Silk Taffeta Costume
